author: theslashveto
body:
If you're using an att based ability like Osmostrike or volley, you'll want to avoid debuffs like the att-, maybe use a panacea to remove it 

I'll also suggest deific channel

You might also have attacks that do more damage than volley, but you'll need to watch your mana -- probably worth it when raiding

Since you're storm Force you do bonus electric damage to enemies that aren't resistant or immune

author: petr1petr
body:
you are mixing pet build with melee build - pick one..

in first picture, you show raid setup, on last picture, you show stats for world layout (no +view distance items in world setup? why?)

for melee - switch specialization to charmer and use warrriors pavane (skill from charmer). boost your atk stat - with items, with boosts. see if you have any ward items, for survival.

for pet build - switch class to bahamut, put on gerd items, get some real dmg pet (nidhogg for example) - slot gerd items with ward - you survive, pet does dmg

get some jorm (fey jorm) scrolls - pretty good equips for starting T10..

author: No-Fly-5019
body:
If you are going with summoner try this method it will save you the time and effort of minmaxing:

I'd suggest the best way to level up is to switch to summoner. Dual witch staves. Dual monster tomes. Mimic head with exp. High ward chest or summoner protection. Legs with ward or summoner protection. Exp potion and daily exp bonus then farm bosses. Once u hit desired level try to find Luck gear like Arisen Horror or Horror. Questing staves. Treat bags or band of gods with mimic head in order to find ur future class best in slot gear. Once u get what u wanted. Switch to Orn bonus gear to get ur desired class. Enjoy. It will take you few months rather than years. 

Your welcome.

PS. Never do towers with ur summoner unless u reach 30k ward and have Buggane (if ur level less than 240).

Get Baldr gear for ward before you do towers.
